description: Multi-hop narrative queries: each names 2 companies, so a complete answer must draw evidence from BOTH. Metric = company coverage (fraction of required companies present in the retrieved / cited sources). Config E (agentic decompose + per-hop retrieve + recovery) vs single-pass narrative.
